what: Stacked photos change every 5 seconds. The current one slides 25% to the right while being clipped away from the left up to 75% (clip inset 0 0 0 75%). The next one, hiding 75% from the right at 25% on the left (inset 0 75% 0 0), slides in and unfolds. Both use the same .7s power3.in, so they rush through at the end. Pressing a dot or sending fx:go goes to that slide (going to a previous one slides the reverse way). Pauses when off screen
needs: CustomEase (when giving a curve as values)

options.every: Auto-advance interval (seconds), default 5 — at 0 it does not advance on its own and moves only by dots or fx:go (where scroll changes the section)
options.ease: Curve — GSAP name or 0.58,-0.05,0.78,0.17, default power3.in
options.shift: Push distance (% of section width), default 25
options.cut: Share cropped while being pushed (%), default 75
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Sheets to overlay (children) — two or more
options.[data-fx-part=dot]: (if present) dot buttons — same order as the sections, data-on on the current section. Placed inside the panel because the panel is overflow hidden
options.fx:go: on the panel CustomEvent("fx:go", { detail: { index, back } }) sends to that section — if back is true it enters from the right
options.fx:slide: Fired by the panel on flip (detail.index) — use when changing the section number and text together

from.where: about.html .a-slogan__sp (two slogan photos, original about.js: at the Splide 5s advance, GSAP .7s power3.in with x ±25% and clip 75%) · index.html .h-mv (hero banner, 4.5s, the Splide thumbnail row handles the advance) · .h-three (three promises, .5s sine.in when the row passes screen center, every: 0 + fx:go)
from.options: Tagline every: 5 · hero every: 4.5 · three promises every: 0; dur: .5; ease: sine.in
